verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly says it "charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets." The Agents SDK docs add that agents hibernate when idle and each "costs nothing when inactive," which directly delivers on paying for active compute rather than idle time. Missing for 10: first-party pricing documentation detailing CPU-time billing units, rates and how I/O wait is excluded, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of actual bills.
